articles.title_en: Do color-coded Nutrition Facts Panels nudge the use of nutrition information?
articles.title_cn: 彩色编码营养标签是否促使消费者使用营养信息？
articles.abstract_en: Nutrition Facts labels or Nutrition Facts Panel(s) (NFP) are a critical channel for communicating food nutrition information to consumers. A fundamental question is how to help consumers effectively understand and use the label without missing important information. This paper introduces a color-coded NFP and investigates its impacts on information search and consumer behavior, such as attention to information, food choice, and food health perception. Results show that the color-coded NFP attracts more attention than a black-and-white NFP, specifically for nutrients such as fat, sodium, and sugars, which should be limited. Additionally, the color-coded NFP made it easier for consumers to make food purchase decisions and led consumers to make healthier choices for some products (e.g., chips). Finally, the color-coded NFP reduces the time needed and contributes to a more accurate evaluation of the products’ healthiness in the case of chips, reducing the information processing costs and increasing the utilization of information. Our research demonstrates that the color-coded NFP is more attractive, efficient, and effective in delivering nutrition information and contributes to a healthier decision for some products (e.g., chips) than the traditional NFP.
articles.abstract_cn: 营养标签或营养事实面板（NFP）是向消费者传达食品营养信息的关键渠道。一个基本问题是如何帮助消费者有效理解和使用标签，而不遗漏重要信息。本文引入了一种彩色编码的NFP，并研究了其对信息搜索和消费者行为的影响，如对信息的关注、食品选择和食品健康感知。结果表明，彩色编码的NFP比黑白NFP吸引了更多关注，特别是对于脂肪、钠和糖等应限制的营养素。此外，彩色编码的NFP使消费者更容易做出食品购买决策，并促使消费者对某些产品（如薯片）做出更健康的选择。最后，彩色编码的NFP减少了所需时间，并在薯片的情况下有助于更准确地评估产品的健康性，降低了信息处理成本并提高了信息利用率。我们的研究表明，与传统NFP相比，彩色编码的NFP在传递营养信息方面更具吸引力、更高效、更有效，并有助于对某些产品（如薯片）做出更健康的决策。

articles.title_en: Diet and disease: Examining the seasonal determinants of children’s health in Senegal
articles.title_cn: 饮食与疾病：考察塞内加尔儿童健康的季节性决定因素
articles.abstract_en: Seasonal changes in food availability and disease incidence put pressure on children’s health in Sub-Sahara Africa. Using year-round survey data from Senegal, we examine how seasonality in key health inputs (dietary diversity, diarrhea, and fever) helps predict seasonality in children’s health (weight-for-height z-score). We first parameterize seasonal variation in health and health inputs using second-order trigonometric polynomials, then decompose the seasonal curve of children’s health into component parts explained by seasonality in each health input. We find that lagged seasonality in disease incidence predicts seasonality in child health, while seasonality in dietary diversity does not — likely because diets are poor in Senegal even during the most food-plentiful part of the year. We also observe noticeable heterogeneity in the way these health inputs predict children’s health across different wealth levels and regions.
articles.abstract_cn: 撒哈拉以南非洲地区食物供应和疾病发病率的季节性变化给儿童健康带来压力。利用塞内加尔的全年调查数据，我们考察了关键健康投入（饮食多样性、腹泻和发烧）的季节性如何有助于预测儿童健康（身高别体重z分数）的季节性。我们首先使用二阶三角多项式对健康和健康投入的季节性变化进行参数化，然后将儿童健康的季节性曲线分解为由各健康投入的季节性解释的组成部分。我们发现，疾病发病率的滞后季节性预测了儿童健康的季节性，而饮食多样性的季节性则没有——这可能是因为即使在一年中食物最丰富的时期，塞内加尔的饮食也很差。我们还观察到这些健康投入在不同财富水平和地区预测儿童健康的方式存在显著异质性。

articles.title_en: Insuring consumption against Shocks: The role of informal savings in Nigeria
articles.title_cn: 保障消费免受冲击：尼日利亚非正式储蓄的作用
articles.abstract_en: In most low-income countries, households are exposed to a plethora of economic shocks with welfare-reducing consequences. In the absence of well-functioning financial markets, most households rely on informal savings through credit clubs/groups to reduce their vulnerability to these shocks. In this paper, we examine the extent to which participation in informal savings associations affects the ability of households to smooth their consumption in the face of both idiosyncratic and covariate shocks. Using a difference-in-difference fixed effects specification on the Nigerian household-level panel that spans four waves over eight years, with data collected in 2010/2011, 2012/2013, 2015/2016 and 2018/2019, we documented heterogenous effects of informal savings. The results suggest that informal savings help households to hedge consumption against rainfall shocks. We find heterogeneous effects of informal savings in insuring consumption against idiosyncratic shocks, depending on whether households live in urban or rural areas. These results provide new insights into the role of informal financial arrangements in sub-Saharan Africa.
articles.abstract_cn: 在大多数低收入国家，家庭面临众多经济冲击，这些冲击会降低福利。在金融市场功能不健全的情况下，大多数家庭通过信贷俱乐部/团体的非正式储蓄来减少对这些冲击的脆弱性。在本文中，我们考察了参与非正式储蓄协会对家庭在面对特质性和协变量冲击时平滑消费能力的影响程度。利用尼日利亚家庭层面面板数据，该数据跨越八年四轮，数据收集于2010/2011、2012/2013、2015/2016和2018/2019年，我们采用双重差分固定效应模型，记录了非正式储蓄的异质性效应。结果表明，非正式储蓄帮助家庭对冲降雨冲击对消费的影响。我们发现非正式储蓄在保障消费免受特质性冲击方面存在异质性效应，这取决于家庭居住在城市还是农村地区。这些结果为撒哈拉以南非洲非正式金融安排的作用提供了新的见解。

articles.title_en: Expanding the phytosanitary exclusion zone for Mexican avocados: Market impacts and unintended consequences
articles.title_cn: 扩大墨西哥鳄梨植物检疫排除区：市场影响与意外后果
articles.abstract_en: Due to phytosanitary concerns, the U.S. has historically only allowed the importation of avocados from one Mexican state—Michoacán. In Michoacán, avocados have become a source of cartel conflict and violence. In August 2022, authorized shipments of avocados from an additional Mexican state – Jalisco – were allowed to enter the U.S. This research investigates the market impacts and unintended consequences of expanding the phytosanitary exclusion zone for Mexican avocados. We find that expansion of the phytosanitary exclusion zone was unequivocally beneficial from the perspective of U.S. avocado users and consumers. However, economic outcomes in the Mexican market are more nuanced, and temporal relationships suggest expansion of the phytosanitary exclusion zone may have affected cartel-related activity both in Michoacán and Jalisco.
articles.abstract_cn: 由于植物检疫方面的担忧，美国历来只允许从墨西哥的一个州——米却肯州——进口鳄梨。在米却肯州，鳄梨已成为卡特尔冲突和暴力的根源。2022年八月，来自墨西哥另一个州——哈利斯科州——的授权鳄梨 shipments 被允许进入美国。本研究调查了扩大墨西哥鳄梨植物检疫排除区的市场影响和意外后果。我们发现，从美国鳄梨使用者和消费者的角度来看，扩大植物检疫排除区无疑是有益的。然而，墨西哥市场的经济结果则更为微妙，时间关系表明，扩大植物检疫排除区可能影响了米却肯州和哈利斯科州的卡特尔相关活动。

articles.title_en: The transition incentive program and women farmers in the USA
articles.title_cn: 过渡激励计划与美国女性农民
articles.abstract_en: The US Department of Agriculture made women farmers eligible for the Transition Incentive Program (TIP) to improve their access to farmland. TIP is a federal program that transfers near-expiring lands in the Conservation Reserve Program (CRP) back to agricultural use while maintaining established conservation practices. It offers incentives to landowners and requires recipients to adhere to specific conservation plans on the acquired land. Since women have shown a stronger interest in sustainable practices and face more limited access to land, TIP has the potential to enhance women’s presence in farming. However, the program’s effectiveness has not been evaluated.
articles.abstract_cn: 美国农业部使女性农民有资格参加过渡激励计划（TIP），以改善她们获得农田的机会。TIP是一项联邦计划，将保护储备计划（CRP）中即将到期的土地转回农业用途，同时维持既定的保护措施。它向土地所有者提供激励，并要求接受者在获得的土地上遵守特定的保护计划。由于女性对可持续实践表现出更强的兴趣，并且面临更有限的土地获取途径，TIP有潜力增强女性在农业中的存在。然而，该计划的有效性尚未得到评估。

articles.title_en: Food policy coherence in local government: Who does what and why?
articles.title_cn: 地方政府中的食品政策一致性：谁做什么，为什么？
articles.abstract_en: In the UK, food policy is often made by national government, but typically interpreted and implemented by councils. This research explores which local government functions are involved in food policy, how they work together and how coherent their policy positions are. It builds on earlier work to map the food policy actors at national government level and to understand local government’s many functions.
articles.abstract_cn: 在英国，食品政策通常由国家政府制定，但通常由地方议会解释和实施。本研究探讨了哪些地方政府职能涉及食品政策，它们如何协同工作，以及它们的政策立场有多一致。它建立在早期工作的基础上，以绘制国家政府层面的食品政策行动者，并理解地方政府的众多职能。

articles.title_en: Potential implications of trade policy shifts after the 2024 U.S. presidential election for the agri-food sector
articles.title_cn: 2024年美国总统大选后贸易政策转变对农业食品部门的潜在影响
articles.abstract_en: •U.S. trade policy shifts could severely impact agricultural exports by up to 34.4 %.•Projected losses in U.S. agricultural exports range from $6.8 billion to $60.6 billion.•Scenario analysis shows the agricultural sector could face its worst crisis since the 1980s.•Policy recommendations emphasize bolstering domestic value-added agriculture and forming new trade partnerships.•Trade retaliation effects underscore the need for careful consideration of future trade policies.
articles.abstract_cn: •美国贸易政策转变可能严重影响农业出口，降幅高达34.4%。•预计美国农业出口损失在6.8亿美元至60.6亿美元之间。•情景分析显示，农业部门可能面临自1980年以来最严重的危机。•政策建议强调加强国内附加值农业和建立新的贸易伙伴关系。•贸易报复效应凸显了未来贸易政策需谨慎考虑的必要性。

articles.title_en: Examining purchasing strategies in public food procurement: Integrating sustainability, nutrition, and health in Spanish school meals and social care centres
articles.title_cn: 审视公共食品采购中的采购策略：整合西班牙学校餐食和社会照护中心的可持续性、营养与健康
articles.abstract_en: Sustainable Public Food Procurement (SPFP) is pivotal in advancing sustainable and healthier food systems. However, practical gaps persist in understanding how policies function at the local implementation. This study addresses these gaps by analysing 22 SPFP contracts for school meals and social care centres in Spain, focusing on implementation while contextualizing findings within the broader policy cycle. This research categorizes SPFP criteria in tenders and evaluate their potential for actionability across sustainability, nutrition, & health dimensions. It also explores how these criteria are combined into purchasing strategies to achieve simultaneous or individual goals. Key findings reveal a strong use of product quality criteria, particularly organic foods, supported by policy and ease of implementation. However, non-ambitious targets, market constraints and procurement officers’ limited knowledge hinder progress. The study highlights significant adoption of nutritional & health criteria, though non-mandatory policies and varying regional targets impede consistent implementation and reveal gaps in promoting healthy and sustainable dietary practices. Environmental criteria are widely used signalling policy priorities within the EU policy framework. In contrast, proximity and social criteria are underutilized due to regulatory constraints and insufficient guidance. Despite these challenges, innovative local procurement strategies are utilized to overcome barriers. At the strategy level, the study reveals diverse approaches to SPFP implementation, highlighting adaptability but underscoring the need for flexible frameworks that accommodate local variations while aligning with broader EU or national goals. This research advocates for a holistic approach to SPFP that addresses both the practical challenges of implementation and the systemic issues present in the earlier stages of policy development.
articles.abstract_cn: 可持续公共食品采购（SPFP）在推进可持续和更健康的食品系统方面至关重要。然而，在理解政策如何在地方实施层面运作方面，仍存在实际差距。本研究通过分析西班牙学校餐食和社会照护中心的22份SPFP合同来解决这些差距，重点关注实施情况，并将研究结果置于更广泛的政策周期背景中。本研究对招标中的SPFP标准进行分类，并评估其在可持续性、营养与健康维度上的可操作性潜力。研究还探讨了这些标准如何被组合成采购策略，以实现同时或单独的目标。主要发现显示，产品品质标准（尤其是有机食品）得到广泛使用，这得益于政策支持和易于实施。然而，非雄心勃勃的目标、市场约束和采购官员有限的知识阻碍了进展。研究强调了营养与健康标准的大量采用，尽管非强制性政策和各异的区域目标阻碍了持续实施，并揭示了在促进健康和可持续饮食实践方面的差距。环境标准被广泛使用，标志着欧盟政策框架内的政策优先事项。相比之下，邻近性和社会标准由于监管约束和指导不足而未被充分利用。尽管存在这些挑战，创新的地方采购策略被用来克服障碍。在策略层面，研究揭示了SPFP实施的多样化方法，强调了适应性，但同时也指出了需要灵活框架，以适应地方差异并与更广泛的欧盟或国家目标保持一致。本研究倡导对SPFP采取整体方法，既解决实施的实际挑战，也解决政策发展早期阶段存在的系统性问题。

articles.title_en: Information interventions and willingness to pay for PICS bags: Evidence from Sierra Leone
articles.title_cn: 信息干预与PICS袋支付意愿：来自塞拉利昂的证据
articles.abstract_en: This study investigates the different impact of informational interventions on smallholder farmers’ willingness to pay (WTP) for Purdue Improved Crop Storage (PICS) bags in Sierra Leone. Despite the proven efficacy of PICS bags in reducing post-harvest losses and maintaining crop quality, their adoption rates remain extremely low in Sierra Leone. Through a field experiment with random assignment involving 436 households, this research investigates how health and profit-oriented information impacts farmers’ valuation of PICS bags. Participants were randomly assigned to one of three groups: receiving health benefits information, receiving profit benefits information, or a control group receiving standard usage instructions. Both treatment groups also received the standard usage instructions provided to the control group. The WTP was assessed using the Becker–DeGroot–Marschak (BDM) auction method. Results indicate that while profit-related information significantly increases WTP, health information does not. Additionally, this study explores heterogeneity in treatment effects, finding that there is no significant variation in response across different demographic and socioeconomic groups, pointing to a potential uniformity in the effectiveness of the informational interventions.
articles.abstract_cn: 本研究调查了信息干预对塞拉利昂小农对普渡改进作物储存（PICS）袋支付意愿（WTP）的不同影响。尽管PICS袋在减少收获后损失和保持作物质量方面已被证明有效，但其在塞拉利昂的采用率仍然极低。通过一项涉及436户家庭的随机分配田间实验，本研究探讨了健康和利润导向信息如何影响农民对PICS袋的估值。参与者被随机分配到三组之一：接受健康益处信息、接受利润益处信息，或接受标准使用说明的对照组。两个处理组也接受了提供给对照组的标准使用说明。支付意愿通过Becker–DeGroot–Marschak（BDM）拍卖方法进行评估。结果表明，虽然利润相关信息显著提高了支付意愿，但健康信息并未产生显著影响。此外，本研究探讨了处理效应的异质性，发现不同人口和社会经济群体之间的反应没有显著差异，这表明信息干预的有效性可能具有一致性。

articles.title_en: Small wins in practice: Learnings from 16 European initiatives working towards the transformation of urban food systems
articles.title_cn: 实践中的小胜利：来自欧洲16项城市食品系统转型倡议的经验
articles.abstract_en: In this study, we examine how 16 initiatives across Europe are addressing ‘wicked’ food system issues by mobilising local networks and implementing small-scale but impactful changes in urban and peri-urban regions. To map the potential of these initiatives to contribute to large-scale change, we apply the Small Wins Framework proposed by Termeer & Dewulf (2019). By analysing data collected through interviews with participants working on initiatives spanning 13 cities across 9 European countries, we identify the manifestation of six propelling mechanisms that signal the capacity of small wins to bring about systemic change. Findings from this study reveal the presence of most mechanisms across the included initiatives. However, the ways in which these mechanisms appear depend on various factors such as stakeholder motivation, the maturity of the initiative, the need for additional funding, local food culture, and the regional and national political landscape among others. Our analysis indicates that the Small Wins Framework could be successfully used as a mapping tool in urban transformation processes, but it is likely to be more effective as a tool for reflexive monitoring rather than ex-post evaluation. Drawing on the impacts of various large-scale disruptions on the initiatives, we suggest that social, political, and economic shocks can present windows of opportunity to accelerate change and that initiatives performing well under such pressure should be supported in their pursuit of systems transformation. Lastly, we recommend non-linear growth strategies such as spreading, deepening, and expanding, as ways to compound the impact of small wins.
articles.abstract_cn: 在本研究中，我们考察了欧洲16项倡议如何通过动员地方网络并在城市和城郊地区实施小规模但具有影响力的变革，来应对“棘手”的食品系统问题。为了描绘这些倡议对大规模变革的潜在贡献，我们应用了Termeer & Dewulf（2019）提出的“小胜利框架”。通过分析对涉及欧洲9个国家13个城市的倡议参与者的访谈数据，我们识别出六种推动机制的表现，这些机制标志着小胜利带来系统性变革的能力。研究结果显示，所纳入的倡议中大多数机制均有所体现。然而，这些机制的表现方式取决于多种因素，如利益相关者的动机、倡议的成熟度、额外资金需求、当地食品文化以及区域和国家政治格局等。我们的分析表明，小胜利框架可以成功地用作城市转型过程中的绘图工具，但作为反思性监测工具而非事后评估工具可能更为有效。借鉴各种大规模干扰对倡议的影响，我们认为社会、政治和经济冲击可以成为加速变革的机遇窗口，而在这种压力下表现良好的倡议应在其系统转型追求中得到支持。最后，我们建议采用非线性增长策略，如扩散、深化和扩展，以加大小胜利的影响。

articles.title_en: Viewpoint: Toward a sustainable Green Revolution in sub-Saharan Africa: The case of maize and rice
articles.title_cn: 观点：迈向撒哈拉以南非洲的可持续绿色革命——以玉米和水稻为例
articles.abstract_en: This Viewpoint article synthesizes seminal research from multiple disciplines in a virtual special collection (VSC) of Elsevier articles to highlight critical remaining steps to achieve a sustainable Green Revolution (SGR) in Africa. It is now widely recognized that the combined use of improved seeds and inorganic fertilizers – which were critical to the Asian Green Revolution – are necessary but insufficient conditions for African farmers to sustainably raise the productivity of their cereal crops. We highlight three key conclusions emerging from the VSC. First, achieving a maize SGR in sub-Saharan Africa (SSA) will require the development of site-specific soil management practices that can be consistently applied by highly resource-constrained farmers. This condition is far from being achieved in most of SSA. Second, the challenges to achieving a rice SGR are different: Best management practices are largely established and effective. Rice yields have already increased dramatically in parts of SSA where Asian-style seed-fertilizer technology and cultivation practices have been adopted. Therefore, the priority for enhancing rice productivity in SSA is to promote wider adoption of these established practices in rice-producing areas. Third, overcoming these challenges for both maize and rice requires strong adaptive agricultural research, development, and extension organizations on the ground. Many African countries currently lack these organizations to carry out the core activities required to achieve a SGR; therefore, building institutional capacity for national and regional agricultural research, extension, and policy analysis is a fundamental component of an effective SGR strategy.
articles.abstract_cn: 这篇观点文章综合了多个学科的开创性研究，收录于爱思唯尔文章的一个虚拟特辑（VSC）中，旨在强调在非洲实现可持续绿色革命（SGR）尚需采取的关键步骤。人们现已广泛认识到，改良种子与无机肥料的结合使用——这对亚洲绿色革命至关重要——是非洲农民可持续提高其谷类作物生产力的必要条件，但并非充分条件。我们强调了从VSC中得出的三个关键结论。首先，在撒哈拉以南非洲（SSA）实现玉米可持续绿色革命，需要开发针对特定地点的土壤管理实践，这些实践能够被资源极度受限的农民持续应用。这一条件在SSA大部分地区远未实现。其次，实现水稻可持续绿色革命面临的挑战不同：最佳管理实践已基本建立并有效。在SSA部分地区，采用亚洲式种子-肥料技术和耕作实践后，水稻产量已大幅提高。因此，提高SSA水稻生产力的优先事项是在水稻产区推广这些既有实践的更广泛应用。第三，克服玉米和水稻的这些挑战，需要强大的适应性农业研究、推广和开发组织实地运作。许多非洲国家目前缺乏这些组织来开展实现可持续绿色革命所需的核心活动；因此，建设国家和区域农业研究、推广和政策分析方面的机构能力，是有效可持续绿色革命战略的基本组成部分。

articles.title_en: How do women’s empowerment metrics measure up? A comparative analysis
articles.title_cn: 女性赋权指标如何衡量？一项比较分析
articles.abstract_en: Research has identified women’s empowerment as a critical factor for nutritional outcomes and a priority area for understanding women’s mental health status. At the same time, there is no consensus on how empowerment should be measured. The surrounding debate has produced several empowerment metrics that are widely used, yet we know little about whether they can be substituted for one another or their respective strengths and weaknesses. Using data collected from a single sample of women from rural, northern Kenya, we compare five empowerment metrics: The Project-level Women’s Empowerment in Agriculture Index (pro-WEAI) and associated Health and Nutrition Module (HN), Women’s Empowerment in Nutrition Index (WENI), Women’s Empowerment in Livestock Index (WELI), and the Survey Based Women’s Empowerment Index (SWPER). The metrics have shared theoretical origins and are commonly used in the food, nutrition and health spaces to study rural women’s lives across low- and middle-income countries. We examine the metrics’ characteristics, distributions, pairwise correlations and capacity of each metric to predict outcomes often associated with the concept of empowerment: body mass index (BMI) and the Center for Epidemiologic Studies Depression Scale (CES-D). We find striking differences between these common empowerment metrics. The metrics’ correlations with one another are highly variable as are the predictive capacities for both outcomes. Further, our analysis finds that the choice of metric can dramatically influence which individuals are identified as empowered. In sum, our results suggest that while these metrics are used in remarkably similar ways to understand rural women’s empowerment and its consequences, unless they are computed with many identical survey questions, the metrics do not capture the same underlying concept and are not interchangeable. We recommend that our work be replicated elsewhere and caution should be taken when implementing and interpreting research using these metrics, as findings may be highly sensitive to the choice of metric.
articles.abstract_cn: 研究已确定女性赋权是营养结果的关键因素，也是理解女性心理健康状况的优先领域。与此同时，关于如何衡量赋权尚未达成共识。围绕这一争论产生了多种广泛使用的赋权指标，但我们对其是否可以相互替代或各自的优缺点知之甚少。利用从肯尼亚北部农村单一女性样本收集的数据，我们比较了五种赋权指标：项目级农业女性赋权指数（pro-WEAI）及其相关的健康与营养模块（HN）、营养赋权指数（WENI）、畜牧业女性赋权指数（WELI）以及基于调查的女性赋权指数（SWPER）。这些指标具有共同的理论起源，常用于食品、营养和健康领域，以研究中低收入国家农村女性的生活。我们考察了这些指标的特征、分布、两两相关性以及每个指标预测通常与赋权概念相关的结果的能力：体重指数（BMI）和流行病学研究中心抑郁量表（CES-D）。我们发现这些常见赋权指标之间存在显著差异。指标之间的相关性高度可变，对两种结果的预测能力也是如此。此外，我们的分析发现，指标的选择可能极大地影响哪些个体被识别为赋权。总之，我们的结果表明，尽管这些指标以非常相似的方式用于理解农村女性赋权及其后果，但除非它们由许多相同的调查问题计算得出，否则这些指标并不能捕捉相同的潜在概念，且不可互换。我们建议在其他地方复制我们的工作，并在使用这些指标进行实施和解释研究时应谨慎，因为研究结果可能对指标的选择高度敏感。

articles.title_en: Perspectives on high U.S. retail food prices during 2020–2022
articles.title_cn: 2020-2022年美国零售食品价格高企的视角
articles.abstract_en: The recent food price inflation has sparked lively debates globally in media accounts, policy circles, and academics. A large body of literature has emerged across several fields of economics. However, each study typically focuses on a single or subset of causes, indicating that factors contributing to the recent food price inflation are broadly ranging and complex. This paper provides a comprehensive synthesis of what we learned about the major causes of high food prices in 2020–2022 in the United States and how they differ from those identified in prior food price hikes during the Great Recession of 2008. To provide context, we first discuss stylized facts about the U.S. food industry structure and previous empirical evidence on economy-wide drivers of high food prices. We then survey the literature on drivers of price surges observed since 2020. We document that the overall price surge, including food prices, in 2020–2022 has some unique factors primarily stemming from the consequences of the COVID-19 pandemic—specifically, U.S. fiscal support and money supply growth are the leading factors. Like in 2008, high commodity prices played a significant role in recent food price hikes—although their impacts might not be as large as in 2008. Inflation expectations due to high oil prices were a significant factor in 2008 but were not found to be an essential cause of the recent price hikes. Furthermore, the evidence on the role of factors directly related to retailers’ conduct, such as seller’s inflation or price gouging, is mixed. Considering our synthesis, we identify important gaps where future research is needed and policy priorities.
articles.abstract_cn: 近期的食品价格通胀已在媒体、政策界和学术界引发了全球性的激烈辩论。经济学多个领域涌现了大量文献。然而，每项研究通常只关注单一或部分原因，表明导致近期食品价格通胀的因素广泛且复杂。本文对2020-2022年美国食品价格高企的主要原因及其与2008年大衰退期间先前食品价格上涨原因的差异进行了全面综合。为提供背景，我们首先讨论美国食品行业结构的典型事实以及先前关于经济-wide驱动因素对高食品价格影响的实证证据。然后，我们综述了自2020年以来观察到的价格飙升驱动因素的文献。我们记录了2020-2022年整体价格飙升（包括食品价格）具有一些独特因素，主要源于COVID-19大流行的后果——具体而言，美国的财政支持和货币供应增长是主要因素。与2008年类似，高商品价格在近期食品价格上涨中发挥了重要作用——尽管其影响可能不如2008年那么大。由于高油价导致的通胀预期在2008年是一个重要因素，但并未被发现是近期价格上涨的关键原因。此外，关于与零售商行为直接相关的因素（如卖方通胀或价格欺诈）的证据不一。基于我们的综合，我们指出了未来研究需要的重要空白和政策优先事项。

articles.title_en: Too much, too soon? Early-maturing maize varieties as drought escape strategy in Malawi
articles.title_cn: 太多、太快？早熟玉米品种作为马拉维干旱逃避策略
articles.abstract_en: Adopting early-maturing maize varieties can substantially increase yield and yield stability in suitable environments. Actionable recommendations that specify where early-maturing varieties can be suitably applied are lacking across low-income countries. We found for maize in Malawi that varieties with longer maturity duration provide on average the highest yield. However, if water stress occurs, we found that its timing determines which seed variety performs best. If water stress conditions are confined to the late season, early-maturing varieties escape drought and perform better than medium- and late-maturing varieties. Instead, if water stress conditions start already from mid-season, early-maturing varieties perform worst. Our results demonstrate that the typical seasonal timing of water stress can serve as a suitable criterion for recommending where to adopt early-maturing varieties. Finally, we propose an integrated research framework that complements our econometric analysis and allows to derive actionable variety suitability recommendations at the country level.
articles.abstract_cn: 采用早熟玉米品种可以在适宜环境中显著提高产量和产量稳定性。在低收入国家，缺乏具体说明早熟品种在哪些地方可以适宜应用的可行建议。我们发现，在马拉维的玉米中，成熟期较长的品种平均产量最高。然而，如果发生水分胁迫，我们发现其发生时间决定了哪个种子品种表现最佳。如果水分胁迫仅限于季节后期，早熟品种能够逃避干旱，表现优于中熟和晚熟品种。相反，如果水分胁迫从季节中期就开始，早熟品种表现最差。我们的结果表明，水分胁迫的典型季节性时间可以作为推荐采用早熟品种的适宜标准。最后，我们提出了一个综合研究框架，补充了我们的计量经济分析，并能够在国家层面得出可行的品种适宜性建议。

articles.title_en: Do moral constraints and government interventions promote the willingness and behaviors of food saving among urban residents in China? An empirical study based on structural equation model
articles.title_cn: 道德约束与政府干预是否促进了中国城市居民节约食物的意愿与行为？基于结构方程模型的实证研究
articles.abstract_en: As income rises and the food supply becomes more sufficient, food waste becomes increasingly severe in emerging economies. Promoting food conservation behaviors among residents is crucial; however, there is little evidence of the consumer-related driving factors behind this behavior from both internal and external perspectives. Based on the theory of planned behavior and the structural equation model, this paper examines the impact mechanism of internal moral constraints and external government intervention on the psychology of saving food among Chinese urban residents in one research framework. Survey data combined from random street-stop interviews and an online survey are applied. Results show that moral constraints, as internal factors, still play a crucial role in forming Chinese urban residents’ willingness to save food. The most influencing mechanisms are through impacts on attitude (personal moral cognition) (β = 0.311) and perceived behavioral control (comparison of economic and moral costs and benefits) (β = 0.581). In the meantime, government interventions, as external factors, significantly impact residents’ willingness and behavior to save food. The government’s efforts in guiding food conservation have a direct promoting effect (β = 0.135) on the respondents’ food-saving willingness, while services and support to food conservation from the government directly promote food-saving behaviors (β = 0.068). Also, the number of household generations and respondent age positively impact food saving willingness, while chronic diseases, income, and food consumption expenditure have adverse impacts. Policies encouraging food saving need to conduct from both internal and external intervention. On the one hand, it demands to strengthen residents’ moral constrains by promoting traditional virtues and improving the awareness of global food security challenges, which can increase the benefits of food saving behaviors in terms of moral values. On the other hand, government intervention on guiding and supporting food conservation can effectively increase both willingness and behaviors of food saving.
articles.abstract_cn: 随着收入增加和食品供应更加充足，新兴经济体的食物浪费问题日益严重。促进居民的节约食物行为至关重要；然而，从内部和外部角度探讨该行为背后的消费者相关驱动因素的证据很少。基于计划行为理论和结构方程模型，本文在一个研究框架内考察了内部道德约束和外部政府干预对中国城市居民节约食物心理的影响机制。采用了随机街头拦截访谈和在线调查相结合的调查数据。结果表明，作为内部因素的道德约束在形成中国城市居民节约食物意愿方面仍发挥着关键作用。其影响机制主要通过影响态度（个人道德认知）（β = 0.311）和感知行为控制（经济与道德成本收益比较）（β = 0.581）来实现。同时，作为外部因素的政府干预显著影响居民节约食物的意愿和行为。政府在引导节约食物方面的努力对受访者的节约食物意愿有直接促进作用（β = 0.135），而政府对节约食物的服务和支持则直接促进节约食物行为（β = 0.068）。此外，家庭代际数量和受访者年龄对节约食物意愿有正向影响，而慢性疾病、收入和食品消费支出则有不利影响。鼓励节约食物的政策需要从内部和外部干预两方面进行。一方面，需要通过弘扬传统美德和提高对全球粮食安全挑战的认识来加强居民的道德约束，这可以增加节约食物行为在道德价值方面的收益。另一方面，政府在引导和支持节约食物方面的干预可以有效提高节约食物的意愿和行为。

articles.title_en: Short food supply chains: The influence of outlet and accessibility on farmer and consumer preferences. Two discrete choice experiments
articles.title_cn: 短食品供应链：销售点和可达性对农民和消费者偏好的影响。两项离散选择实验
articles.abstract_en: In France, Short Food Supply Chains (SFSCs) operate under specific regulatory frameworks, involving either direct sales or transactions with no more than one intermediary. SFSCs are of particular interest to local communities as they offer a potential pathway to enhancing food security through the local provisioning of urban areas. This study investigates both consumers’ and farmers’ preferences for different SFSC outlets. Harmonized discrete choice experiments (DCEs) were conducted in 2022 in France, involving 1,021 consumers and 154 market gardeners, focusing on the consumption and sale of fresh vegetables. The objective is to examine the consistency and divergence between farmers’ and consumers’ choices among different outlets and attributes. The results indicate that consumers are less sensitive to the type of outlet than farmers. For consumers, relational proximity—direct interaction with farmers—emerges as a key factor, whereas farmers value this proximity only when it does not entail additional logistical burdens. Furthermore, mutual aid among farmers is highly appreciated, with farmers willing to lower prices when collaborating on tasks such as delivery. The findings suggest that travel time and outlet accessibility are critical, with longer travel times negatively affecting consumers more than farmers. These insights provide valuable guidance for enhancing SFSCs development, suggesting that policymakers should prioritize improving outlet accessibility, promoting farmer collaboration, and addressing logistical costs to better align supply with demand.
articles.abstract_cn: 在法国，短食品供应链（SFSCs）在特定的监管框架下运作，涉及直接销售或不超过一个中间商的交易。SFSCs对当地社区尤为重要，因为它们通过城市地区的本地供应为提高食品安全提供了潜在途径。本研究调查了消费者和农民对不同SFSC销售点的偏好。2022年在法国进行了统一的离散选择实验（DCEs），涉及1,021名消费者和154名市场菜农，重点关注新鲜蔬菜的消费和销售。目的是考察农民和消费者在不同销售点和属性之间的选择的一致性和分歧。结果表明，消费者对销售点类型的敏感度低于农民。对于消费者而言，关系邻近性——与农民的直接互动——成为关键因素，而农民只有在不增加额外物流负担时才重视这种邻近性。此外，农民之间的互助受到高度赞赏，农民在合作执行如配送等任务时愿意降低价格。研究结果表明，出行时间和销售点的可达性至关重要，较长的出行时间对消费者的负面影响大于农民。这些见解为促进SFSCs发展提供了有价值的指导，建议政策制定者优先改善销售点的可达性，促进农民合作，并解决物流成本，以更好地使供给与需求对齐。
